method.official_source_policy: Only primary auction records, current first-party operator pages, Companies House or Charity Commission records and official local-authority planning or regulatory routes are promoted. Directory-only claims and inferred lease completion are rejected.
method.current_status_policy: A current shop or venue page, active company or charity record, regulatory entry or planning-search route can verify identity and activity but does not prove executed lease terms, legal completion or exact parcel geometry.
method.parcel_binding_policy: NO_DATA_NOT_INFERRED until exact title or canonical geometry is read.
